name: City Apartment
description: Urban essentials with transit and dining tips

data.title: Welcome to the City
data.subtitle: Your home base in the heart of town

data.message: Welcome to your city apartment. Everything you need is within walking distance - we hope you enjoy the neighborhood as much as we do.

rules.title: No Smoking
rules.description: Smoking and vaping are not allowed anywhere inside the property.

rules.title: No Parties or Events
rules.description: Parties and events are not allowed. Only registered guests may stay overnight.

rules.title: Quiet Hours
rules.description: Please keep noise low between 22:00 and 08:00 out of respect for the neighbours.

rules.title: Respect the Neighbours
rules.description: Please walk softly and avoid moving furniture, especially in the evening.

data.instructions: Drop keys in the lockbox. Take the train downtown for your onward journey!
